ling-sem-01-c1.text: Zalta, Edward N (2024). Gottlob Frege. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
ling-sem-01-c1.quote: The descriptions ‘the morning star’ and ‘the evening star’ denote the same planet, namely Venus,
ling-sem-01-c1.claim: 'The morning star' and 'the evening star' both refer to Venus.
